story.title: Our Story
story.content: Kayvi Solar was founded with a simple mission: to make clean, renewable energy accessible and affordable for everyone. Over the past decade, we have grown from a small local installer into one of the most trusted solar providers in the region, helping thousands of homeowners and businesses reduce their carbon footprint and take control of their energy costs.
